summary: Describes how to produce digital signatures and hashes with the GOST R 34.10-2012 and GOST R 34.11-2012 algorithms for DNSKEY, RRSIG, and DS records in DNSSEC. It is informational, so it documents use of the algorithms rather than setting a standard.

eli5.summary: Domain name records can be stamped with a seal to prove they are real. This explains how to make that seal using Russia's national seal-making recipe.
